C6.doc: 14:C6, 14:X4 — the Tsirelson square: with `ζ = g^m` and `ζ' = g^{7m}` its inverse (`ζζ' = 1`), `(ζ + ζ')² = 2` and `(2(ζ + ζ'))² = 8` on every frame of capacity `κ = 2m`; hence `2` is a square on every such shell — the direction "octant ⇒ c-square" of X4's second face (the converse is `even_capacity_of_two_square` below; the equivalence `two_is_square_iff`).

C6.name: FRC.Entropy.octant_iff
C6.doc: 14:C6 — the octant sector at tier 0, as an equivalence: on every frame, an element with `ζ⁴ = −1` and `ζ⁸ = 1` exists exactly when the capacity is even.

C6.name: FRC.Entropy.lab_carrier
C6.doc: 14:A2, 14:C6 — the laboratory Carrier `Ω = 2 408 561`, host-decided values: `4S + 1 = Ω` with `S = 602 140` even and `≡ 1 (mod 3)`, the octant sector realised — in the chart with drive `6`, `ζ₈ = 6³⁰¹⁰⁷⁰ = 1 639 587`, `ζ₈⁴ = −1`, `ζ₈⁸ = 1`, `ζ₈⁻¹ = 1 111 186`, `(ζ₈ + ζ₈⁻¹)² = 2`, `(2(ζ₈ + ζ₈⁻¹))² = 8`.

C7.name: FRC.Entropy.octant_inversion
C7.doc: 14:C7, 14:X3 [ΛCDM] — the octant inversion: given the octant's `π/4` (C5, whose realisation content is not formalised here), the rival chart's identity gives `t₀H_Λ = π/4` at `Ω_Λ = tanh²(3π/8)` and, for `0 ≤ Ω_Λ < 1`, only there.

C7.name: FRC.Entropy.landing_bracket
C7.doc: 14:C7, 14:X3 — the landing bracketed: `0.68368 < tanh²(3π/8) < 0.68369` (the numeral `0.6837`) is certified from `π` to six places, `e` to nine and the Taylor tail; and, with the Planck numerals `0.685 ± 0.007` taken as data (A8), the deviation lies between `0.18σ` and `0.19σ`.

C8.name: FRC.Entropy.channel_one_consistency
C8.doc: 14:C8 [ΛCDM] — the channel-1 consistency: with `Λ = 3Ω_Λ H₀²/c²` (the definition of `Ω_Λ`) the asymptotic rate is `H_Λ = c√(Λ/3) = H₀√Ω_Λ`, and the locus read on it, `H_Λ/tanh(3π/8)`, returns `H₀` exactly when `Ω_Λ = tanh²(3π/8)`; at the fitted `0.685` the return is within `0.1 %` (`channel_one_numeral`).

C8.name: FRC.Entropy.channel_one_numeral
C8.doc: 14:C8 — the channel-1 return bracketed: at the fitted `Ω_Λ = 0.685` (A8, taken as data) the locus returns `H_Λ/tanh(3π/8) = H₀ √0.685/tanh(3π/8)` with `1 < √0.685/tanh(3π/8) < 1.001` — the channel-1 `H₀` to `0.1 %`.

C8.name: FRC.Entropy.cluster_identity
C8.doc: 14:C8 [ΛCDM] — the two-cluster chart identity: with `S = π (r_H/ℓ_P)²`, a `Λ`-face reading `r_H = c/(H₀√Ω_Λ)` against a rate-face reading `r_H = c/H_rate` gives `S_Λ/S_rate = (H_rate/H₀)²/Ω_Λ` — the definition of `Ω_Λ` read on the rows, the Hubble tension displayed and no framework content.

C9.name: FRC.Entropy.count_face
C9.doc: 14:C9 [chart] — the count face and its chart dress: `S = π x²` with `x = r_H/ℓ_P > 0` gives `x = √(S/π)` and `√S = √π · x`, the solid-angle `π` the declared transport between the count face `√S` and the drawn width.

C10.name: FRC.Entropy.capacity_zero
C10.doc: 14:C10 — the primality behind the capacity axis's identifications: `κ = 1` (the bare proton) is a shell, `𝔽₅`; `κ = 2` has no shell (`9` is composite); `κ_H = 3` (ground-state hydrogen, the first non-trivial Object) is the shell `𝔽₁₃`.

C10.name: FRC.Entropy.capacity_axis
C10.doc: 14:C10, 14:B10 — the primality behind the capacity axis: `κ = 1` (the bare proton) is the shell `𝔽₅`, `κ = 2` has no shell (`9` composite), `κ_H = 3` (hydrogen, `N = 1`) is `𝔽₁₃`; the `3N` shell at `N = 3` (`37`), none at `N = 2` (`25`).

X2.name: FRC.Entropy.milgrom_rebooking
X2.doc: 14:X2 [chart] — Milgrom's rebooking, the substitution `h = 2πħ`: the floor `a₀ = cH/2π` is `cHħ/h`, the per-cycle rate budget per step. That the `2π` carries zero freedom is X2's realisation clause (B2 fixes the convention), not formal content.

X3.name: FRC.Entropy.octant_inversion
X3.doc: 14:C7, 14:X3 [ΛCDM] — the octant inversion: given the octant's `π/4` (C5, whose realisation content is not formalised here), the rival chart's identity gives `t₀H_Λ = π/4` at `Ω_Λ = tanh²(3π/8)` and, for `0 ≤ Ω_Λ < 1`, only there.

X3.name: FRC.Entropy.landing_bracket
X3.doc: 14:C7, 14:X3 — the landing bracketed: `0.68368 < tanh²(3π/8) < 0.68369` (the numeral `0.6837`) is certified from `π` to six places, `e` to nine and the Taylor tail; and, with the Planck numerals `0.685 ± 0.007` taken as data (A8), the deviation lies between `0.18σ` and `0.19σ`.

X4.name: FRC.Entropy.octant_second_face
X4.doc: 14:X4 — the arithmetic face of the second face: the c-square (`2` a square in `𝔽_Ω`) holds exactly when the octant sector exists — the two congruence faces coincide on every Carrier. The reading of the octant as the well-definedness of the measured age is X4's realisation clause, not formal content.

X4.name: FRC.Entropy.octant_sector_iff
X4.doc: 14:C6, 14:X4 — the arithmetic face: the octant sector `C₈ ⊂ C_{4S}` exists exactly when `8 ∣ 4S`, that is when `S` is even (X4's claim about what certifies the congruence is a realisation clause, not this equivalence).

X4.name: FRC.Entropy.two_is_square_iff
X4.doc: 14:X4 — the second face as an equivalence at tier 0: on every frame `(τ; 0, 1, g)`, `2` is a square exactly when the capacity is even — the c-square congruence and the octant sector are one condition.

P3.name: FRC.Entropy.age_rate_locus
P3.doc: 14:P3 [ΛCDM] — the algebraic locus: with `t H_Λ = π/4` (the octant), `H_Λ = H₀ √Ω_Λ` and `Ω_Λ = tanh²(3π/8)`, `t H₀ = (π/4)/tanh(3π/8)`; the numeral `0.950` is bracketed in `locus_bracket`; the stellar-age reading `H₀ = 68.2 ± 1.7` and its confrontations are not formalised.

P3.name: FRC.Entropy.locus_bracket
P3.doc: 14:P3 — the locus's numeral bracketed: `0.9498 < (π/4)/tanh(3π/8) < 0.9499`, the paper's `0.950`.

P4.name: FRC.Entropy.fluid_w
P4.doc: 14:B8, 14:P4 [ΛCDM] — the arithmetic of the effective-fluid reading: the rival chart's continuity law `ρ̇ + 3H(ρ + p) = 0` with `ρ̇ = 0` (a fixed cardinality admits no evolution) and `H ≠ 0` gives `p = −ρ`, `w = p/ρ = −1` exactly. B8's single-component clause and P4's `w₀w_a` rigidity are realisation content, not formalised.
